name: ArtStation

sources.title: ArtStation for Artists — free edition always available: portfolio, free website, prints, learning
ArtStation Help — every account gets artstation.com/username community profile plus username.artstation.com website

requirements: Free account ('there will always be a free edition') — register at artstation.com; the /register URL 403'd to automated fetch but signup is the standard account flow
Content is artwork/media: images, video, Marmoset/Sketchfab 3D, 360 panos — a 'listing' means publishing artwork to a portfolio, so it fits only if you have genuine visual/design work
Artwork must be your own; ArtStation is a professional art community with strong norms against spam/AI-scraped content
preparation: Original artwork assets (project images, renders, process shots)
Artist/company display name and bio; website link for the profile
Decide which work to publish first — the community profile and the free portfolio site both populate from posted artwork
workflow: Sign up for a free ArtStation account
Complete the community profile (name, bio, website, social links)
Upload artwork via 'Add artwork'/portfolio tools — each post supports images, video, 3D embeds, breakdowns
Publish — the artwork appears on the community profile artstation.com/<username> and the free site <username>.artstation.com
Optionally add work/production experience to the profile
watchFor: Not a product-launch venue — posting a SaaS landing page screenshot as 'artwork' is off-norm; suitable for design/visual products or branding showcases only
artstation.com/register returns 403 to non-browser fetches — expect bot protection on signup
Premium subscription is an upsell (custom domain, more website themes) but not required for the free profile+site
Community is sensitive to generative-AI art; check current AI-content policy before posting AI imagery
countsAsLive: Profile artstation.com/<username> and site <username>.artstation.com are public and display at least one published artwork
unknowns: Whether profile website links are follow or nofollow
Current policy on AI-generated artwork disclosures
Any new-account review before artwork appears publicly
